description.value: The 27th Street Grille is the full-service restaurant within Divya Sutra Plaza & Conference Centre, a 138-room hotel in the heart of Vernon's North Okanagan. The hotel complex includes a swimming pool, sauna, and large on-site parking lot described as accommodating trucks with boats or small trailers. Touring cyclists staying or dining here would have access to a full suite of hotel amenities in a centrally located Vernon property.
